purpose: Introduce the reason for a preceding claim.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Claim。なぜなら + reason + からだ / のだ
I will go by bicycle today, because the trains are not running.
I support this proposal, because it keeps costs down.
He cannot come, because he is away on business.
formation: Claim。なぜなら + reason + からだ / のだ
restrictions: The reason normally follows, rather than being a question asked of someone.
mistake: なぜなら sets up an explanation; なぜ asks why.
